correctness.rationale: For each n>=4, the centered Rayleigh vector gives a global SLEM lower bound and a strictly positive hub-holding penalty. Equality in the minimum Rayleigh quotient fixes every incident edge. Exact 3-by-3 quotient factorization gives eigenvalues 1,t,-lambda, and the remaining invariant block is (1-p)I-L_W. Its full real spectrum lies in [-t,t] exactly for the printed Laplacian window. Uniform internal weights yield zero transverse eigenvalues, establishing attainment. The proof treats reducible kernels, arbitrary nonnegative internal weights and all boundary cases. Standalone symbolic polynomial identities and 68 reproducibility assertions ran successfully; finite tests are not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The 2004 Boyd et al. work exactly covers n=3, so the new theorem starts at n>=4. The original 2004 four-state dual witness naturally suggests a generalization but does not assert the infinite family or non-invariant optimizer spectral polytope. Direct comparison of that original article and the 2009 equal-clique-bridge theorem found no stated stronger result including the claim; Publicly indexed mathematical records were searched on object, aliases, parameters and implication. Possible unindexed literature is a residual risk and independent verification is absent.
residual_risks: Unindexed exact treatments of clique-and-leaf chains, or an unequal two-clique bridge with a singleton side, may overlap the statement.
The 2004 four-state example makes the n-dependent formula a plausible generalization; value resides in the all-n optimizer-face and rigorous structural assertions rather than the four-state value.
An earlier technical report of the focal 2004 paper is known at month precision (February 2003); its exact first public date is not established.
Database retrieval is neither exhaustive nor proof of uniqueness of a result in the literature. Independent audit has not been performed.

value.rationale: The result converts an SDP over a dense graph with one rare leaf into a closed formula and an exact, not merely symmetric, optimizer-face characterization for all n>=4. It shows forced bridge/hub probabilities, precise free internal design weights, an explicit per-unit hub-holding penalty and constant limiting optimal spectral mixing despite the clique size diverging. These structural design and rigidity results are not the old four-state tabulation.
